```{r}
BssRmdVolumeOutput <-
  R6::R6Class("BssRmdSurfaceOutput",
              inherit = BssRmdOutput,
              public = list(
                initialize = function(outdir = NULL) {
                  super$initialize(outdir)
                },
                save_out = function(bss_data, bss_model, MNIcoord=NULL) {
                  
                }
              ),
              private = list(
                #overlay choices: pvalues, adjpvalues, tvalues, atlas
                render_overlay = function(MNIcoord, atlas = bss_data@atlas_filename, overlay="pvalues", outdir) {
                  intern = FALSE
                  ignore.stdout = FALSE
                  ignore.stderr = FALSE
                  wait = TRUE
                  input = NULL
                  
                  view1 <- paste0("volblend -r ",atlas," --view 1 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o atlas.",MNIcoord,".p.png -c jet -i ",overlay," -o ",outdir, overlay,"1.png")
                  view2 <- paste0("volblend -r ",atlas," --view 2 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o atlas.",MNIcoord,".p.png -c jet -i ",overlay," -o ",outdir, overlay,"2.png")
                  view3 <- paste0("volblend -r ",atlas," --view 3 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o atlas.",MNIcoord,".p.png -c jet -i ",overlay," -o ",outdir, overlay,"3.png")
                  
                  return(c(system(view1, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input), system(view2, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input), system(view3, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input)))
                },
                render_atlas = function(MNIcoord, atlas = bss_data@atlas_filename, overlay="atlas", outdir) {
                  intern = FALSE
                  ignore.stdout = FALSE
                  ignore.stderr = FALSE
                  wait = TRUE
                  input = NULL
                  
                  view1 <- paste0("volblend -i ",atlas," --view 1 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o ", outdir, overlay,"1.png")
                  view2 <- paste0("volblend -i ",atlas," --view 2 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o ", outdir, overlay,"2.png")
                  view3 <- paste0("volblend -i ",atlas," --view 3 --slice ",MNIcoord," --flop -o ", outdir, overlay,"3.png")
                  
                  return(c(system(view1, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input), system(view2, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input), system(view3, intern, ignore.stdout, ignore.stderr, wait, input)))
                  
                },
                render_table = function() {
                  library(knitr)
                  table <- data.frame(Cluster = 1:5, Vol_Size = c(33,22.3, 21, 25, 30), MNI_coord = c(3,3,4,5,3), T_val =c(8,7.2,6,9.8,7.8))
                  table$Cluster <- paste0("[", table$Cluster, "](", t, ")")
                  kable(table[1:4], align=c(rep('l', 4)))
                },
                render_html = function() {
                  library(shiny)
  library(shinyjs)
  shinyUI(fluidPage(
    useShinyjs(),
    tabsetPanel(
      id = "navbar",
      tabPanel(title = "Cluster 1",
               checkboxGroupInput("variable", "Variables to show:",
                                  c("P-Values" = "p",
                                    "Adjusted P-val" = "adp",
                                    "T-Values" = "t",
                                    "Atlas" = "at"), inline=T, selected = c("p","adp","t","at")),
               tableOutput("data"),
               value = c("Cluster 1"),
               h1("Cluster 1"),
               img(src='./pvalues1.png', align="left", width = "28.8%"),
               img(src='./pvalues3.png', align="left", width = "24%"),
               img(src='./pvalues2.png', align="left", width = "34.5%"),
               img(src='./bss_anova_age_mri.bfc.nii_log_pvalues_cbar.pdf', align="left", width = "11%"),
               img(src='./adjpvalues2.png', align="left",width = "28.8%"),
               img(src='./adjpvalues1.png', align="left", width = "24%"),
               img(src='./adjpvalues3.png', align="left", width = "34.5%"),
               img(src='./bss_anova_age_mri.bfc.nii_log_pvalues_adjusted_cbar.pdf', align="left", width = "11%"),
               img(src='./tvalues2.png', align="left",width = "28.8%"),
               img(src='./tvalues1.png', align="left",width = "24%"),
               img(src='./tvalues3.png', align="left",width = "34.5%"),
               img(src='./bss_anova_age_mri.bfc.nii_tvalues_cbar.pdf', align="left", width = "11%"),
               img(src='./atlas2.png', align="left",width = "28.8%"),
               img(src='./atlas1.png', align="left",width = "24%"),
               img(src='./atlas3.png', align="left",width = "34.5%")),
      tabPanel(title = "Cluster 2",
               
               value = "tab2",
               h1("Cluster 2")
      ),
      tabPanel(title = "Cluster 3",
               value = "tab3",
               h1("Cluster 3:"),
              mainPanel("hi")
              
               )
      )
    )
  )  
                  
                }
              )
  )
```
